answer: A staking registry can stop Sybil attacks: every agent must lock a meaningful deposit to join the marketplace, like planting one tree per orchard plot instead of claiming the whole field. Identity is tied to a marble-hard reputation ledger where each transaction leaves a crystal-clear, auditable trail. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, and bad behavior burns the stake, so flooding the economy becomes more expensive than any profit it could yield.
